official_session.source: Android HCI snoop extracted via bugreport

connection.note: OFFICIAL_CONNECTION_INTERVAL_DIFFERENT: final interval 11.25 ms vs 7.50 ms; official applied 4 link-layer updates, harness 1

security.note: both links unbonded and unencrypted -> D2-U-008 REFUTED

att_gatt.note: same MTU (64) and same handles; the earlier 23-MTU reading was only Android's initial default exchange

writes_before_d2: D6 a504d67f (full config read, 8 reply fragments)

application_sequence.note: EXTRA_OFFICIAL_WRITE_OBSERVED: the app performs a device-info + full-config read burst (EF, E2, D4, D6) that the harness omits; the harness additionally pre-clears D2, which the app does not

d2.note: IDENTICAL D2 command, write type, handle and echo behaviour

rx.note: OFFICIAL_WORKS_HARNESS_SILENT: with A pressed the official app receives 155 valid A5 12 02 frames; the harness received none in its 10 s idle window (and the official app also produces none while idle - the stream is event-driven)

earliest_proven_material_difference.detail: official final interval 11.25 ms after 4 link-layer updates; harness 7.50 ms after 1
earliest_proven_material_difference.when: within the first ~3 s of the connection (earliest of all differences)

first_protocol_level_difference.detail: EF (a50cef0000000000000000a0), E2, D4 and a full D6 config read (8 fragments) precede the official D2 enable; the harness sends only 0B
first_protocol_level_difference.when: ~59 s after connect, ~9 s before the D2 enable
first_protocol_level_difference.causality: NOT established - explicitly NOT labelled MISSING_PRECONDITION

leakage: no unknown official traffic was replayed from Linux
